methods.steps: luminance-hdr-cli -l environment.hdr --tmo mantiuk06 -o <tone-mapped file>
methods.limits: -l loads an HDR, --tmo selects the tone mapping operator (default mantiuk06), -o names the tone mapped LDR file and -q sets its quality from 1 to 100.

methods.steps: Open the HDR; export it as a JPEG; set the JPEG options such as Quality and Progressive.
methods.limits: GIMP's Radiance RGBE loader (extension hdr) is registered in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gimp/master/plug-ins/common/file-gegl.c

methods.steps: magick environment.hdr preview.jpeg
methods.limits: The formats page lists HDR (Radiance RGBE image format) and JPEG as both read and write.

methods.steps: heif-dec camera.heif picture.webp
methods.limits: The README says heif-dec converts all images stored in an HEIF/AVIF file to JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or Y4M.

methods.steps: Open the HEIF; export it as WebP; set Source Type, Lossless, Image quality or Alpha quality in the WebP dialog.
methods.limits: HEIF import and export were added in GIMP 2.10.2: https://www.gimp.org/news/2018/05/20/gimp-2-10-2-released/

methods.steps: magick camera.heic website.webp
methods.limits: The formats page lists HEIC (requires the libheif delegate library) and WEBP (requires the WEBP delegate library), both read and write.

methods.steps: Open the ICNS; export it as SVG; set Embed raster layers as to PNG (always).
methods.limits: GIMP's Apple Icon Image plug-in registers a loader for icns files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gimp/master/plug-ins/file-icns/file-icns.c. The other Embed raster layers as choices are JPEG (for opaque images, PNG otherwise) and Do not export raster layers.

methods.steps: iconutil -c iconset Brand.icns; open one extracted picture in GIMP; export it as SVG; set Embed raster layers as to PNG (always).
methods.limits: iconutil -c iconset <icns filename> converts an icns file to an iconset, written next to the icns file unless -o names another location; the SVG options are listed at https://docs.gimp.org/3.2/en/file-svg-export.html

methods.steps: Open the ICNS in Pillow, which reads the largest available icon by default, and save it as selected.bmp; potrace -s -o mark.svg selected.bmp.
methods.limits: Pillow reads and writes BMP files containing 1, L, P or RGB data (https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/handbook/image-file-formats.html). Potrace reads BMP and PBM, PGM and PPM, -s selects SVG output, and non-black-and-white input is converted with a simple threshold.

methods.steps: Open the ICO; export it as PDF by choosing the .pdf extension; check Layers as pages and Fill transparent areas with background color.
methods.limits: Layers as pages creates one page per layer and is disabled with one layer; Fill transparent areas replaces transparent areas with the background color. GIMP's ICO loader (extension ico): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gimp/master/plug-ins/file-ico/ico.c

methods.steps: Open the ICO, which Pillow reads at its largest available icon, and save a PDF.
methods.limits: PDF saving: L, RGB and CMYK images use JPEG encoding; LA and RGBA images use JPEG2000 encoding; P images use HEX encoding.

methods.steps: magick badge.ico badge.pdf
methods.limits: The formats page lists ICO as read and PDF as read and write.

methods.steps: Open the ICO; export it as TGA; set Use RLE compression and Origin (Bottom left or Top left).
methods.limits: The TGA export dialog has two options: Use RLE compression and Origin. GIMP's ICO loader (extension ico): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gimp/master/plug-ins/file-ico/ico.c

methods.steps: magick cursor-art.ico sprite.tga
methods.limits: The formats page lists ICO as read and TGA as read and write.

methods.steps: Open the ICO, which Pillow reads at its largest available icon, and save a .tga; compression="tga_rle" writes it run-length encoded.
methods.limits: The largest available icon is read; compression set to tga_rle makes the TGA run-length encoded.

methods.steps: Open the ICO; export it as WebP; set Source Type to Icon and check Lossless if wanted.
methods.limits: The WebP export dialog lists Source Type (Default, Picture, Photo, Drawing, Icon, Text) and Lossless. GIMP's ICO loader (extension ico): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GNOME/gimp/master/plug-ins/file-ico/ico.c

methods.steps: Open the ICO, which Pillow reads at its largest available icon, and save a .webp with lossless=True.
methods.limits: lossless: if present and true, instructs the WebP writer to use lossless compression.

methods.steps: magick site-icon.ico -define webp:lossless=true site-art.webp
methods.limits: The webp:lossless define encodes the image without any quality loss; the formats page lists WEBP as needing the WebP delegate library and ICO as readable: https://imagemagick.org/formats/

methods.steps: Open the JPEG; export with a .hdr name or choose Radiance RGBE as the file type; no export dialog opens.
methods.limits: There are no settings to choose from, and the export starts automatically after you choose the filename.

methods.steps: magick photograph.jpeg environment.hdr
methods.limits: The formats page lists HDR (Radiance RGBE image format) and JPEG as both read and write.

methods.steps: Read the JPEG with imread; write it with imwrite under a .hdr file name.
methods.limits: imwrite chooses the format from the filename extension; the imread list gives Radiance HDR as *.hdr, *.pic.

methods.steps: cjxl photograph.jpeg reversible.jxl
methods.limits: Usage is cjxl [options] input [output.jxl]; lossy sources such as JPEG files are compressed losslessly by default and the original JPEG can then be reconstructed bit-for-bit.

methods.steps: Open the JPEG and export it as JXL; the dialog lists Lossless, Compression/maxError, Effort/Speed, Bit depth, Export as CMYK, Save Exif and Save XMP.
methods.limits: The JPEG XL export dialog options as listed on the page.

methods.steps: magick photograph.jpeg modern.jxl
methods.limits: The formats page lists JXL as read and write, needing the JPEG XL delegate library.

methods.steps: jpegtopnm photograph.jpeg > samples.ppm
methods.limits: jpegtopnm writes to standard output; a grayscale JFIF input produces a PGM image, any other input a PPM.

methods.steps: Open the JPEG and export it to a PPM file; set Data formatting to ASCII or RAW.
methods.limits: PPM saves a color RGB image without transparency; RAW is more compact and results in smaller files.

methods.steps: magick photograph.jpeg samples.ppm
methods.limits: The formats page lists PPM (Netpbm color pixmap format) and JPEG as both read and write.

methods.steps: magick photo.jpeg -depth 8 rgb:photo.rgb; read it back with magick -size 640x480 -depth 8 rgb:photo.rgb photo.png
methods.limits: The formats page lists RGB as raw red, green, blue sample streams that need size and depth parameters; the command-line processing page forces raw streams with a format prefix, as in magick -size 640x480 -depth 8 rgb:image image.png.

methods.steps: image = Image.open(JPEG); write image.tobytes() to a binary file; record image.size
methods.limits: tobytes returns the image as a bytes object; size is the 2-tuple (width, height) in pixels.

methods.steps: Open the JPEG; export as Raw image data; set Planar configuration to Contiguous or Planar.
methods.limits: The raw export dialog lists Planar configuration (Contiguous or Planar) and Palette's layout.
